class.name: SimpleTerrainData
class.description:
[SimpleTerrainData] stores a square terrain height field. The terrain contains [member grid_size] quads per axis and therefore stores [code](grid_size + 1) * (grid_size + 1)[/code] height values. New resources initialize as a flat height field. Random terrain generation is an explicit [SimpleTerrain3D] editor/runtime action instead of the default state. This resource is registered through ClassDB and can be created or modified from scripts. Assign it to [member SimpleTerrain3D.simple_terrain_data] to render and edit the stored heights. [codeblock] var data := SimpleTerrainData.new() data.resize(128, 1.0, true) data.set_height(64, 64, 4.0)
var terrain := SimpleTerrain3D.new() terrain.simple_terrain_data = data terrain.rebuild_mesh() add_child(terrain) [/codeblock]

method.name: ensure_height_data_size
method.description: Resizes [member height_data] to match [member grid_size]. If [param clear_existing] is [code]true[/code], all heights are reset to [code]0.0[/code]; otherwise existing values are preserved up to the new array size. This is useful after script-side edits to [member grid_size].

method.name: fill_flat
method.description: Fills the whole height field with [param height] and emits a resource change notification.

method.name: get_height
method.description: Returns the height at vertex coordinate [param x], [param z]. Coordinates are vertex indices, not world-space positions.

method.name: get_height_index
method.description: Returns the flat array index in [member height_data] for vertex coordinate [param x], [param z]. The index is calculated as [code]z * get_vertex_count() + x[/code].

method.name: get_vertex_count
method.description: Returns the number of vertices per terrain axis. This is always [member grid_size] + [code]1[/code].

method.name: resize
method.description: Updates [member grid_size] and [member cell_size], then resizes [member height_data]. If this resource is assigned to a [SimpleTerrain3D], the terrain will rebuild when the resource emits its change notification.

method.name: set_height
method.description: Sets the height at vertex coordinate [param x], [param z] and emits a resource change notification. For many edits, modifying [member height_data] in bulk and then assigning it back through [SimpleTerrain3D.height_data] can be more efficient.

members.member: World-space distance between neighboring terrain vertices.
Number of terrain quads per axis. A value of [code]64[/code] means [code]65 * 65[/code] height values.

Flat array of height values. The expected size is [code](grid_size + 1) * (grid_size + 1)[/code]. Set this through the property or [method set_height_data] so the resource can normalize the size and notify listeners.
